gate: Provocation is the felt drive at the core of this code, the impulse to poke at what has gone numb until it twitches back to life. Not cruelty, not contrarianism for sport, but a precise needling aimed at the places where a person or a room has forgotten there is spirit underneath the surface arrangement. A person carrying this code feels it as a tension in the body that wants to find the one stuck point in another's emotional field and press on it. Most people mistake the drive for trouble-making, and the carrier sometimes mistakes it for that too, especially when the timing is off and the press lands as nuisance. The real aim is mutative. The provocation, when it lands well, is a small infectious spark that wakes a room into feeling. Misread, it reads as annoyance, moodiness, or picking fights to drain the pressure off.
centre_field: Down at the base of the body-map, square and quiet until it is not, sits the centre this code rides in. It is a pressure centre, an adrenalised stress pump, one of the four motors that drive action through the whole chart. That placement is the teaching. The provocation is not a clever idea arriving from the head, it is a pulse arriving from the floor, on its own timing, pushing upward and outward until it finds release. The root pulses on and off, never steady, and the code lives at the mercy of that rhythm. When the pulse is up, the carrier prods and stirs and finds the soft spot in a room. When the pulse is down, the same body sits in a moodiness that mistakes itself for personal failure. Knowing where the impulse comes from is half the work of carrying it well.
channel: On its own this code reaches across the body-map toward the gate of abundance, the place in the emotional centre that holds the felt knowing that spirit is the actual source of supply. Together the two form the channel of emoting, a wire that runs from the adrenal floor up into feeling. The reach matters. Provocation without that other half has nothing to deliver. It pokes, it stirs, and there is no message inside the poke, only the pressure looking for an exit. Joined, the prod becomes a teaching about where supply truly comes from, and the moodiness becomes a wave with information inside it. Alone, this code is a finger in someone's ribs with no point being made. The code is built to need the abundance gate as its meaning, the way an alarm clock is built to need a morning to wake into.
